about: Held-out cases for the safety check (core/moderation.py): written on 9 November 2026 after the rules were tuned on moderation_cases.json, and run once, untuned, for an honest number (python -m scripts.eval_moderation --set holdout). First run: 17/21, over-moderated 0, missed 4 (the fake doctor's note, the romance scam, the goodbye letters, the insulting reply). The last three were then fixed, so these are no longer held out: for the next honest number, write a new set.
